posts.h:
Hello everyone,

we are now two weeks into the closed beta and so far we had a lot of people registering and many of them were able to play.
We would like to know if you were happy with the beta access.
It was very easy for me but in some servers with 18 people on and a huge map I lagg alot
In all honesty it was pretty good. A few things here or there that I wouldn't mind seeing changed, but other than that it's a decent and pretty solid game.

I absolutely hated the time limits on items. The game itself seemed alright, though. Kind of stopped playing after finding out about the time limits, but I may give it another chance.

As for gaining access, it was really annoying waiting to play something I didn't know would be fun. I was a little disappointed in some of the choices made in the game, and that made the time waiting for access feel wasted. All the points and stuff were confusing, and I didn't really understand the game, since I only played a few matches.

There was plenty of customization, but the expiration dates (as mentioned above) made it annoying. If points weren't so common it would be even more annoying (I'm assuming the 100,000 points are beta only). Nothing good to really say about it, didn't play it enough.

The game itself is pretty good, but I also agree with what Fuze said about the expiration date/time on the items. That's just ridiculous in my opinion. People should be able to keep what they buy.

Also, to find the customization on the character is very difficult ingame, maybe make that easier to find would be a good thing? Otherwise the gameplay feels nice and the graphics is good.
I have not yet experienced any lag so that's a huge plus

Just my 0.02$
at the moment im not getting anywhere with this game i got activated like two days ago and i cant play it because it wont let me update it so if someone can help me i will be thankful

The FPS side is good if a little glichy such as 2 players can shot each other at the same time and things like that. as for the map editor i love it to death but the ui for handling maps could use some work i.e. a delete btn to free up map slots. as for the bad the micro transaction system is a deal breaker for me at least i like to at least feel like i own a gun or map blocks and that just is not there for me with the rental system that is their now. as such i will Not play for a week just to have a gun for a day(little over stated i know but the point stands) and same goes for the building blocks. i will NEVER pay to RENT a digital gun for a week or two. i just don't see the point in spending money on something that is so short term with in a game. just my thoughts on the bata as it stands now

Hello Brick-Force players and testers!I am CCretGuy and i will be explaining some goods/bads/bugs/etc.!

I will continue to update this thread, IF i am not lazy, so STAY TUNED!Highlight if you can't read this, ran out of colors for this !

Goods
  • Sniper QuickScopeing-Switching between during Reload
  • All reloading time EXCEPT MGs(Machine Guns)
  • Damage and balance
  • Speed and Weight
  • Message system and also Whisper system(Should have a better tutorial or helping system with the whisper!)

Needs and Requires Improvements

  • Better Tutorials, more details(Such as the Use key and Walk key)
  • BETTER COLLISION!!!!!!!!!!I'm literally hiting a guy in the face and not Head shooting or Damaging!

  • MGs(Machine Guns) reload time!!!Extremely overpowered since you can easily kill people at close range and reload extremely fast!If your far range, you could always switch to your secondary!
  • Turrets require extremely retuning!!!Extreme spread even when burst firing!!!
  • More Turrets, better Brick-Force Server Upgrades(To fix lag and stuff), Fly/NoClip mode during map edit(Should be a "Brick" ticket purchase!", more Max Bricks/Turrets/Etc.!!!
Bugs

Thanks for reading, and i hope this topic/thread will get views and administrative views and the effect of this topic/thread will bring fourth great improvements! -CCretGuy(I was gonna use Ace but someone toke it already)
